name: zvideo_dd3d_floor_power_of_two
description: zVideo_dd3d::FloorPowerOfTwo returns the largest power of two less than or equal to the input value.
tier_s_evidence: VC5SP3 cl 11.00.7022 x86 /O2 /Ob0 /Zp4 /FAcs COFF byte comparison passed for ?FloorPowerOfTwo@zVideo_dd3d@@YIHH@Z at 0x4ad680 with zero unmasked mismatches and no relocation-masked bytes; 13 trailing VC NOP bytes trimmed.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4ad680 validates fastcall ECX=value, an initial power value of 1, repeated left shift until power >= value, returning value when exactly equal, otherwise returning power >> 1, with no direct callees and no warning tags.
The native smoke verifies exact-power and non-exact inputs including 1, 3, 64, and 65.
